assets.prompt: Create a new photorealistic transparent-background object asset for an adult English coursebook vocabulary task. Portrait canvas, approximately 3:4. Exactly THREE clearly separate groups stacked vertically, evenly spaced, generous transparent gaps: TOP a small loose group of realistic folded paper cash banknotes and a few coins, three-quarter tabletop view; MIDDLE one plain rich cobalt-blue bank payment card with a small gold chip, no brand, no card number, no name, no text; BOTTOM one short upright narrow white paper shopping receipt with just faint gray horizontal print lines, no readable words or numbers, gentle natural paper curl. Each group centered, large and recognizable at small textbook size. Soft realistic material textures, gentle contact shadows with native transparency around them, no people, no hands, no background scene, no surface filling the canvas, no checkerboard pattern baked into pixels, no frame, no labels, no letters, no headings, no extra objects. Receipt remains entirely white with only subtle gray print lines. This is a cutout object study, not a graphic icon set.

Preserve the MIDDLE plain blue chip payment card and the BOTTOM curled white receipt EXACTLY, their positions, size, colors and materials. Preserve the portrait layout, transparent gaps and genuine native alpha transparency. No new labels, no frame, no background, no extra objects. This is a small cash illustration in an English-course shopping vocabulary task using dollar prices. No personal financial data.

assets.prompt: Create ONE brand-new wide realistic editorial photograph, landscape approximately 5:2, for an adult English coursebook about a generic cashier-free grocery store. A friendly female adult shopper in casual aubergine/purple top is at a waist-high entry gate, visibly holding a small plain bank card close to an unbranded contactless card reader on a narrow pedestal. A friendly male store employee in a plain dark-red apron stands a little to the side, openly gesturing toward the reader while answering her question. Both people large in the frame, natural complete hands and heads, medium shot including gate and reader and enough of the floor to understand the entrance. Bright compact modern grocery aisles and shelves of food visible through the gate behind them. This is a store HELP interaction at an entry gate, NOT a checkout counter: no cash register, no conveyor belt, no cashier desk, no basket needing scanning, no robots, no futuristic screens. Neutral natural daylight, strong realistic colors, professional candid lifestyle photograph, full rich believable background. No brand logos, no Amazon branding, no readable text, no sign words, no fake QR code, no watermark, no overlaid graphics or borders. The illustrated fictional scene models one possible entry-card setup; keep all learner labels outside the image. Do not create a collage or repeated frames.
assets.role: Distinct continuation scene: a store employee explains a generic entry-card setup. Illustrative fictional rendering, not an actual Amazon location or product endorsement.
